subject: Detect active unconscious targets in the 180-degree check
description: SuN1Sh1nE Profile_004 Savegame_016 replay-002 diverged after frame 1225 when Soldier90 rejected unconscious PC134 before geometry and LOS, rebuilt its target list, and entered OverviewLookLeft instead of ApproachingSleepingEnemy.
